kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Networks (CNN, TNT, TBS, Discovery, HGTV, etc.) FY24. Déclin structurel cord-cutting, mais marges encore élevées.
kpis.description_en: Networks segment revenue (CNN, TNT, TBS, Discovery, HGTV, etc.) FY24. Structural cord-cutting decline, but margins still high.

kpis.description_fr: Abonnés Direct-to-Consumer (Max + Discovery+) fin FY24. Croissance accélérée par lancement international Max et bundle Disney+/Hulu/Max US.
kpis.description_en: Direct-to-Consumer subscribers (Max + Discovery+) end FY24. Growth accelerated by Max international launch and Disney+/Hulu/Max US bundle.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Studios (Warner Bros Pictures, HBO content, games, TV production) FY24. Volatilité liée au calendrier des sorties.
kpis.description_en: Studios segment revenue (Warner Bros Pictures, HBO content, games, TV production) FY24. Volatility tied to release calendar.

kpis.description_fr: ARPU Direct-to-Consumer FY24. Pression baisse liée à mix géographique (international moins cher) + tier ad-supported.
kpis.description_en: Direct-to-Consumer ARPU FY24. Downward pressure tied to geographic mix (cheaper international) + ad-supported tier.

kpis_story.description_fr: Juin 2025 : annonce séparation en 2 sociétés cotées (Streaming & Studios vs Global Networks) closing prévu mi-2026. Désengagement actifs déclinants.
kpis_story.description_en: June 2025: announcement of split into 2 listed companies (Streaming & Studios vs Global Networks), closing expected mid-2026. Disengage declining assets.
